name: alesa-nova-basic
description: Free guardrails and engineering discipline for AI coding agents. Blocks leaked secrets (including AI-provider keys) before they reach code, a commit or a push; blocks destructive commands and insecure defaults; backs up files before the agent edits them; and sends the agent back when it says 'done' without having run a passing check. Adds project continuity (init, checkpoint, resume), a Coach learning mode, AI-use reports and a self-testing doctor. Runs locally — nothing leaves your machine. English and Bahasa Malaysia.
